title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-06

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with crisp, balanced mix despite several cuts; early‑70 transitional show shines on The Other One and High Time.
ai_review.review: The set captures a solid early‑1970 performance that straddles psychedelic improvisation and the emerging country‑rock vibe. Reviewers rave about the clear, well‑balanced soundboard source and highlight standout moments like a monster "The Other One" and a tight "High Time," though multiple misplaced cuts (especially in "Dancing In The Street") keep it from being flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.3; strong show performance and good soundboard quality offset the noted cuts, leading to a high‑ish overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp vocals, balanced mix, Bob's guitar clear; however six misplaced cuts and occasional “bricked” sections detract from a perfect listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑70 transitional set blending country‑rock with lingering psychedelia; long two‑hour performance with solid song transitions despite a few missing segments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Singing his heart out, vocals spot‑on.
band_member_comments.Phil: Implied bobbing head, good bass foundation (no direct comment).
band_member_comments.Bob: Crisp in the mix and playing great.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums sound great; drum segment praised in Cryptical>TOO sequence.
